newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SWEDISH SHARES HIT HIGH, LED BY ERICSSON.
newsitem.headline: SWEDISH SHARES HIT HIGH, LED BY ERICSSON.

text.p: Swedish shares rose to an intra-day high on Wednesday morning, driven higher by market heavyweight telecoms group Ericsson and watching the latest batch of interim reports.
The Stockholm general index rose 1.03 percent to 3,195.30 after light turnover of 1.21 billion crowns.
"It feels a bit lighter today but more optimistic," said one broker. "The worries around yesterday that Germany would lift interest rates have waned."
Ericsson rose eight to 363.5 crowns after rising in the U.S. alongside the stronger U.S. dollar.
